label: Grandstream GWN7803
description: Grandstream GWN7803 - 28-port Layer 2+ managed switch: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and 4x 1G SFP uplinks, no PoE. 56 Gbps switching capacity, 28 Gbps non-blocking, 41.66 Mpps, 4.1 Mb packet buffer, fanless 1U 440 mm rack/desktop case.

fabric.note: Datasheet Switching Capability 56 Gbps, Total non-blocking throughput 28 Gbps, forwarding rate 41.66 Mpps.

notes: Datasheet: 24 Gigabit Ethernet ports, 4x 1G SFP, 1 console, integrated power supply 30 W, fanless, 2.7 kg. Console 115200 8-N-1 into the CLI. Layer 2+ only, no static routing on this SKU.
